name: K2 Base Camp & Concordia Trek
description: Trek through the longest glacial system outside the polar ice caps, camping at Concordia beneath the shadow of K2, Broad Peak, and the Gasherbrums.

name: Hunza & Shimshal High Passes Traverse
description: Traverse the remote Wakhi high pastures of Shimshal Pamir, crossing high alpine passes and encountering semi-nomadic yak-herding traditions.

name: Nanga Parbat Raikot & Mazeno Ridge
description: Experience the sheer power of the 'Killer Mountain'. Camp at Fairy Meadows, trek to Beyal and explore the sheer Raikot glacial amphitheater.

name: Mont Blanc Summit Expedition
description: Glacier training, acclimatization peaks in the Chamonix valley, and a classic push via the Gouter Ridge to the highest crest of the Alps.

name: Ama Dablam Technical Ridge Climb
description: Known as the 'Matterhorn of the Himalayas', offering world-class granite rock climbing, steep ice gullies, and spectacular exposure on the Southwest Ridge.
